smooth-interface.config.title: Smooth Interface Settings
smooth-interface.config.category.tooltip: The info box shown when you hover an item. These options control its fade, plus the scale and lift it does on appearance.
The overall fade when a screen opens. It works by covering the screen with a black overlay and fading that out.
smooth-interface.config.category.itemCou: The count in the corner of a slot (like "64"). When a screen opens they fade in one after another, in a diagonal wave.
When off, tooltips pop in and out instantly like vanilla.
smooth-interface.config.tooltip.fadeIn.t: How long it takes for a tooltip to become fully visible after you hover an item.
How long it takes for a tooltip to disappear after you stop hovering. Vanilla removes it instantly, so avoid very small values.
smooth-interface.config.tooltip.startSca: The size of the tooltip the moment it appears; 100% means no scaling. Around 80% gives a clear pop.
smooth-interface.config.tooltip.startOff: How many pixels below its final spot the tooltip starts, then floats up. Set to 0 to disable the movement.
smooth-interface.config.screen.enabled.t: When off, screens appear instantly like vanilla.
smooth-interface.config.screen.fadeIn.to: How long the screen takes to go from darkest to fully clear after it opens.
smooth-interface.config.screen.fadeOut.t: Used when the overlay has to be dismissed early. Rarely noticeable; keep it shorter than the fade-in time.
smooth-interface.config.screen.maxDim.to: How dark the overlay is at the very first moment. 0% disables the effect, 100% flashes fully black.
smooth-interface.config.itemCount.enable: When off, count numbers appear instantly like vanilla.
smooth-interface.config.itemCount.fadeIn: How long each slot's number takes to go from transparent to fully visible.
smooth-interface.config.itemCount.fadeOu: How long a number takes to fade out when it disappears, for example when the stack is emptied.
smooth-interface.config.itemCount.change: When the count changes (shift-clicking, for example) the number bounces back to full brightness from this level. 0 means it fades in from fully transparent; keep some brightness if you pick up items rapidly, otherwise the digits stay hard to read.
smooth-interface.config.itemCount.stagge: When a screen opens, how many milliseconds later each slot's number appears compared to the slot to its left or above. 0 makes them all fade in at once.
The maximum accumulated wave delay, so numbers in the bottom-right of a large screen do not wait too long.
